name: Effets Sell In
description: Décomposition de la croissance du chiffre d'affaires du producteur (Sell-in)
overlay_python:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# ========================= Helpers génériques =========================
def trouver_colonne(df, noms_possibles):
    for nom in noms_possibles:
        if nom in df.columns:
            return nom
    lower_map = {c.lower(): c for c in df.columns}
    for nom in noms_possibles:
        if nom.lower() in lower_map:
            return lower_map[nom.lower()]
    return None

def clean_num(s: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    s = s.astype(str)
    s = (s.str.replace(' ', '', regex=False)
           .str.replace(',', '.', regex=False)
           .str.replace('€', '', regex=False)
           .str.replace('$', '', regex=False)
           .str.replace(' ', '', regex=False))
    s = s.str.extract(r'(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)', expand=False)
    return pd.to_numeric(s, errors='coerce').fillna(0.0)

def std_year_labels(df: pd.DataFrame, year_col: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    s = df[year_col].astype(str).str.strip().str.upper()
    if all(x.startswith('N') for x in s.unique()):
        df['__YEAR__'] = s
        return df
    num = pd.to_numeric(df[year_col], errors='coerce')
    if num.notna().any():
        uniq = sorted(num.dropna().unique())
        rankmap = {val: f"N{-i if i>0 else ''}" for i, val in enumerate(uniq[::-1])}
        df['__YEAR__'] = df[year_col].map(rankmap).astype(str)
        return df
    uniq = sorted(df[year_col].unique())
    rankmap = {val: f"N{-i if i>0 else ''}" for i, val in enumerate(uniq[::-1])}
    df['__YEAR__'] = df[year_col].map(rankmap).astype(str)
    return df

def safe_div(num, den):
    if np.isscalar(den):
        return 0.0 if den == 0 else (num / den)
    if isinstance(den, (pd.Series, pd.DataFrame)):
        den2 = den.replace(0, pd.NA)
        out = num / den2
        return out.fillna(0.0)
    num_arr = np.asarray(num, dtype=float)
    den_arr = np.asarray(den, dtype=float)
    with np.errstate(divide='ignore', invalid='ignore'):
        out = np.divide(num_arr, den_arr)
    out = np.where(~np.isfinite(out), 0.0, out)
    return out

def need_cols(colmap, required):
    missing = [k for k in required if not colmap.get(k)]
    if missing:
        raise ValueError(f"Colonnes manquantes (obligatoires): {missing}")

# ========================= Sélection colonnes =========================
aliases = {
    'year'   : ['Année_relative','Annee_relative','Année','Annee','Periode','Période'],
    'arrivee': ['Période_d_arrivée','Periode_d_arrivee','Période_arrivée','Periode_arrivee'],
    'ca'     : ['Chiffre_d_affaires','Chiffre_daffaires','CA','chiffre_d_affaires'],
    'vol'    : ['Volumes','Volume','Unite_volumes'],
    'marque' : ['Marque'],
    'dist'   : ['Distributeur'],
    'ens'    : ['Enseigne'],
    'client' : ['CODE_CLIENT','Code_client','Nom_client','Client'],
    'prod'   : ['Produit'],
    'fmt'    : ['Format'],
}
colmap = {k: trouver_colonne(df, v) for k, v in aliases.items()}

need_cols(colmap, required=['year','ca','vol','marque','dist','ens','client','prod','fmt'])

keep = [colmap[k] for k in ['year','ca','vol','marque','dist','ens','client','prod','fmt']]
if colmap['arrivee']:
    keep.append(colmap['arrivee'])
df = df[keep].copy()

# ========================= Nettoyage =========================
for c in [colmap['marque'], colmap['dist'], colmap['ens'], colmap['client'], colmap['prod'], colmap['fmt']]:
    df[c] = df[c].astype(str).str.strip()

df[colmap['ca']]  = clean_num(df[colmap['ca']])
df[colmap['vol']] = clean_num(df[colmap['vol']])

df = std_year_labels(df, colmap['year'])

order = ['N','N-1','N-2','N-3','N-4','N-5','N-6','N-7','N-8','N-9']
present = [p for p in order if p in set(df['__YEAR__'])]

# Seulement N et N-1
if colmap['arrivee'] and df[colmap['arrivee']].nunique() == 1:
    forced_arr = str(df[colmap['arrivee']].iloc[0]).strip().upper()
    if forced_arr in ['N', 'N-1'] and forced_arr in present:
        arrivals = [forced_arr]
    else:
        arrivals = []
else:
    arrivals = [p for p in ['N', 'N-1'] if p in present]

if not arrivals:
    raise ValueError("Aucune période N ou N-1 disponible.")

# ========================= Boucle multi-périodes =========================
results = []

for ARR in arrivals:
    if ARR == 'N':
        DEP = 'N-1'
    elif ARR == 'N-1':
        DEP = 'N-2'
    else:
        continue

    if DEP not in present:
        continue

    df_pair = df[df['__YEAR__'].isin([DEP, ARR])].copy()

    # -------- Table atomique : TOUTES LES COMBINAISONS --------
    # Créer la liste de toutes les combinaisons (Client × Produit × Format) présentes dans les deux périodes
    atom_keys = [colmap['marque'], colmap['dist'], colmap['ens'], colmap['client'], colmap['prod'], colmap['fmt']]
    
    # Agréger par période
    atom = df_pair.groupby(atom_keys + ['__YEAR__'], as_index=False).agg(
        Vol = (colmap['vol'], 'sum'),
        CA  = (colmap['ca'],  'sum'),
    )
    atom['Prix'] = safe_div(atom['CA'], atom['Vol'])

    # Séparer les périodes
    dep = atom[atom['__YEAR__'] == DEP][atom_keys + ['Vol', 'CA', 'Prix']].rename(columns={
        'Vol': 'Vol_DEP', 'CA': 'CA_DEP', 'Prix': 'Prix_DEP'
    })
    
    arr = atom[atom['__YEAR__'] == ARR][atom_keys + ['Vol', 'CA', 'Prix']].rename(columns={
        'Vol': 'Vol_ARR', 'CA': 'CA_ARR', 'Prix': 'Prix_ARR'
    })

    # -------- Merge outer pour avoir TOUTES les combinaisons --------
    inter = dep.merge(arr, on=atom_keys, how='outer').fillna(0.0)
    
    # -------- TAG Périmètre --------
    def assign_tag(row):
        if row['CA_DEP'] > 0 and row['CA_ARR'] > 0:
            return 'Constant'
        elif row['CA_DEP'] > row['CA_ARR']:
            return 'Perte'
        elif row['CA_ARR'] > row['CA_DEP']:
            return 'Gain'
        else:
            return 'Out'
    
    inter['TAG'] = inter.apply(assign_tag, axis=1)
    
    # -------- Gains / Pertes (VARIATION, pas valeur absolue) --------
    inter['Gains'] = inter.apply(lambda r: r['CA_ARR'] - r['CA_DEP'] if r['TAG'] == 'Gain' else 0, axis=1)
    inter['Pertes'] = inter.apply(lambda r: r['CA_ARR'] - r['CA_DEP'] if r['TAG'] == 'Perte' else 0, axis=1)  # NÉGATIF
    
    # -------- Filtrer périmètre constant --------
    perim_const = inter[inter['TAG'] == 'Constant'].copy()
    
    if perim_const.empty:
        # Pas de périmètre constant
        bd_keys = [colmap['marque'], colmap['dist']]
        
        CA_depart_total = inter.groupby(bd_keys, as_index=False)['CA_DEP'].sum().rename(columns={'CA_DEP': 'CA_depart'})
        Gains_total = inter.groupby(bd_keys, as_index=False)['Gains'].sum().rename(columns={'Gains': 'Gains'})
        Pertes_total = inter.groupby(bd_keys, as_index=False)['Pertes'].sum().rename(columns={'Pertes': 'Pertes'})
        CA_arrivee_total = inter.groupby(bd_keys, as_index=False)['CA_ARR'].sum().rename(columns={'CA_ARR': 'CA_arr_reel'})
        
        out = CA_depart_total.merge(Gains_total, on=bd_keys, how='left') \
                             .merge(Pertes_total, on=bd_keys, how='left') \
                             .merge(CA_arrivee_total, on=bd_keys, how='left').fillna(0.0)
        
        out['Periode_arrivee'] = ARR
        out['Nouveaux_couples_client_produit_format'] = out['Gains']
        out['Couples_perdus_client_produit_format'] = out['Pertes']
        out['Effet_volume_pénétration'] = 0.0
        out['Effet_prix'] = 0.0
        out['Effet_produit'] = 0.0
        out['Effet_format'] = 0.0
        out['Effet_enseigne'] = 0.0
        out['Effet_client'] = 0.0
        out['CA_arrivee_calculé'] = out['CA_depart'] + out['Nouveaux_couples_client_produit_format'] + out['Couples_perdus_client_produit_format']
        out['CA_arrivee_réel'] = out['CA_arr_reel']
        out['Ecart_reconciliation'] = out['CA_arrivee_réel'] - out['CA_arrivee_calculé']
        
        out = out[[colmap['marque'], colmap['dist'], 'Periode_arrivee', 'CA_depart',
                   'Nouveaux_couples_client_produit_format', 'Couples_perdus_client_produit_format',
                   'Effet_volume_pénétration', 'Effet_prix', 'Effet_produit', 'Effet_format',
                   'Effet_enseigne', 'Effet_client', 'CA_arrivee_calculé', 'CA_arrivee_réel', 'Ecart_reconciliation']]
        
        results.append(out)
        continue
    
    # -------- Calcul des agrégats sur périmètre constant - LOGIQUE CORRECTE --------
    perim_keys = [colmap['marque'], colmap['dist']]
    
    # 1. Volume Périmètre (Marque × Dist)
    VolPerim_DEP = perim_const.groupby(perim_keys, as_index=False)['Vol_DEP'].sum().rename(columns={'Vol_DEP': 'VolPerim_DEP'})
    VolPerim_ARR = perim_const.groupby(perim_keys, as_index=False)['Vol_ARR'].sum().rename(columns={'Vol_ARR': 'VolPerim_ARR'})
    perim_const = perim_const.merge(VolPerim_DEP, on=perim_keys, how='left') \
                             .merge(VolPerim_ARR, on=perim_keys, how='left')
    
    # 2. Volume Produit (Marque × Dist × Produit) - pour Mix Produit
    Vol_Prd_DEP = perim_const.groupby(perim_keys + [colmap['prod']], as_index=False)['Vol_DEP'].sum().rename(columns={'Vol_DEP': 'Vol_Prd_DEP'})
    Vol_Prd_ARR = perim_const.groupby(perim_keys + [colmap['prod']], as_index=False)['Vol_ARR'].sum().rename(columns={'Vol_ARR': 'Vol_Prd_ARR'})
    perim_const = perim_const.merge(Vol_Prd_DEP, on=perim_keys + [colmap['prod']], how='left') \
                             .merge(Vol_Prd_ARR, on=perim_keys + [colmap['prod']], how='left')
    
    # Mix Produit = Vol_Produit / Vol_Périmètre
    perim_const['Mix_Prd_DEP'] = safe_div(perim_const['Vol_Prd_DEP'], perim_const['VolPerim_DEP'])
    perim_const['Mix_Prd_ARR'] = safe_div(perim_const['Vol_Prd_ARR'], perim_const['VolPerim_ARR'])
    
    # 3. Volume Format (Marque × Dist × Produit × Format) - pour Mix Format
    Vol_Fmt_DEP = perim_const.groupby(perim_keys + [colmap['prod'], colmap['fmt']], as_index=False)['Vol_DEP'].sum().rename(columns={'Vol_DEP': 'Vol_Fmt_DEP'})
    Vol_Fmt_ARR = perim_const.groupby(perim_keys + [colmap['prod'], colmap['fmt']], as_index=False)['Vol_ARR'].sum().rename(columns={'Vol_ARR': 'Vol_Fmt_ARR'})
    perim_const = perim_const.merge(Vol_Fmt_DEP, on=perim_keys + [colmap['prod'], colmap['fmt']], how='left') \
                             .merge(Vol_Fmt_ARR, on=perim_keys + [colmap['prod'], colmap['fmt']], how='left')
    
    # Mix Format = Vol_Format / Vol_Produit (EN GARDANT PRODUIT CONSTANT)
    perim_const['Mix_Fmt_DEP'] = safe_div(perim_const['Vol_Fmt_DEP'], perim_const['Vol_Prd_DEP'])
    perim_const['Mix_Fmt_ARR'] = safe_div(perim_const['Vol_Fmt_ARR'], perim_const['Vol_Prd_ARR'])
    
    # 4. Volume Enseigne (Marque × Dist × Produit × Format × Enseigne) - pour Mix Enseigne
    Vol_Ens_DEP = perim_const.groupby(perim_keys + [colmap['prod'], colmap['fmt'], colmap['ens']], as_index=False)['Vol_DEP'].sum().rename(columns={'Vol_DEP': 'Vol_Ens_DEP'})
    Vol_Ens_ARR = perim_const.groupby(perim_keys + [colmap['prod'], colmap['fmt'], colmap['ens']], as_index=False)['Vol_ARR'].sum().rename(columns={'Vol_ARR': 'Vol_Ens_ARR'})
    perim_const = perim_const.merge(Vol_Ens_DEP, on=perim_keys + [colmap['prod'], colmap['fmt'], colmap['ens']], how='left') \
                             .merge(Vol_Ens_ARR, on=perim_keys + [colmap['prod'], colmap['fmt'], colmap['ens']], how='left')
    
    # Mix Enseigne = Vol_Enseigne / Vol_Format (EN GARDANT PRODUIT ET FORMAT CONSTANTS)
    perim_const['Mix_Ens_DEP'] = safe_div(perim_const['Vol_Ens_DEP'], perim_const['Vol_Fmt_DEP'])
    perim_const['Mix_Ens_ARR'] = safe_div(perim_const['Vol_Ens_ARR'], perim_const['Vol_Fmt_ARR'])
    
    # 5. Volume Client (Marque × Dist × Produit × Format × Enseigne × Client) - pour Mix Client
    # Vol_Client = Vol_DEP ou Vol_ARR de la ligne (niveau atomique)
    # Mix Client = Vol_ligne / Vol_Enseigne (EN GARDANT PRODUIT, FORMAT, ENSEIGNE CONSTANTS)
    perim_const['Mix_Cli_DEP'] = safe_div(perim_const['Vol_DEP'], perim_const['Vol_Ens_DEP'])
    perim_const['Mix_Cli_ARR'] = safe_div(perim_const['Vol_ARR'], perim_const['Vol_Ens_ARR'])
    
    # -------- Cascade CA : Volume → Produit → Format → Enseigne → Client × Prix --------
    perim_const['CA0'] = (perim_const['VolPerim_DEP'] * perim_const['Mix_Prd_DEP'] * perim_const['Mix_Fmt_DEP'] * 
                          perim_const['Mix_Ens_DEP'] * perim_const['Mix_Cli_DEP'] * perim_const['Prix_DEP'])
    
    perim_const['CA1'] = (perim_const['VolPerim_ARR'] * perim_const['Mix_Prd_DEP'] * perim_const['Mix_Fmt_DEP'] * 
                          perim_const['Mix_Ens_DEP'] * perim_const['Mix_Cli_DEP'] * perim_const['Prix_DEP'])
    
    perim_const['CA2'] = (perim_const['VolPerim_ARR'] * perim_const['Mix_Prd_DEP'] * perim_const['Mix_Fmt_DEP'] * 
                          perim_const['Mix_Ens_DEP'] * perim_const['Mix_Cli_DEP'] * perim_const['Prix_ARR'])
    
    perim_const['CA3'] = (perim_const['VolPerim_ARR'] * perim_const['Mix_Prd_ARR'] * perim_const['Mix_Fmt_DEP'] * 
                          perim_const['Mix_Ens_DEP'] * perim_const['Mix_Cli_DEP'] * perim_const['Prix_ARR'])
    
    perim_const['CA4'] = (perim_const['VolPerim_ARR'] * perim_const['Mix_Prd_ARR'] * perim_const['Mix_Fmt_ARR'] * 
                          perim_const['Mix_Ens_DEP'] * perim_const['Mix_Cli_DEP'] * perim_const['Prix_ARR'])
    
    perim_const['CA5'] = (perim_const['VolPerim_ARR'] * perim_const['Mix_Prd_ARR'] * perim_const['Mix_Fmt_ARR'] * 
                          perim_const['Mix_Ens_ARR'] * perim_const['Mix_Cli_DEP'] * perim_const['Prix_ARR'])
    
    perim_const['CA6'] = (perim_const['VolPerim_ARR'] * perim_const['Mix_Prd_ARR'] * perim_const['Mix_Fmt_ARR'] * 
                          perim_const['Mix_Ens_ARR'] * perim_const['Mix_Cli_ARR'] * perim_const['Prix_ARR'])
    
    # -------- Agrégation finale (Marque × Distributeur) --------
    bd_keys = [colmap['marque'], colmap['dist']]
    
    # CA total départ/arrivée (toute la table inter)
    CA_depart_total = inter.groupby(bd_keys, as_index=False)['CA_DEP'].sum().rename(columns={'CA_DEP': 'CA_depart'})
    Gains_total = inter.groupby(bd_keys, as_index=False)['Gains'].sum().rename(columns={'Gains': 'Gains'})
    Pertes_total = inter.groupby(bd_keys, as_index=False)['Pertes'].sum().rename(columns={'Pertes': 'Pertes'})
    CA_arrivee_total = inter.groupby(bd_keys, as_index=False)['CA_ARR'].sum().rename(columns={'CA_ARR': 'CA_arr_reel'})
    
    # Cascade (périmètre constant)
    agg_cascade = perim_const.groupby(bd_keys, as_index=False)[['CA0','CA1','CA2','CA3','CA4','CA5','CA6']].sum()
    
    # Assembly
    out = CA_depart_total.merge(Gains_total, on=bd_keys, how='left') \
                         .merge(Pertes_total, on=bd_keys, how='left') \
                         .merge(agg_cascade, on=bd_keys, how='left') \
                         .merge(CA_arrivee_total, on=bd_keys, how='left').fillna(0.0)
    
    out['Periode_arrivee'] = ARR
    out['Nouveaux_couples_client_produit_format'] = out['Gains']
    out['Couples_perdus_client_produit_format'] = out['Pertes']
    out['Effet_volume_pénétration'] = out['CA1'] - out['CA0']
    out['Effet_prix'] = out['CA2'] - out['CA1']
    out['Effet_produit'] = out['CA3'] - out['CA2']
    out['Effet_format'] = out['CA4'] - out['CA3']
    out['Effet_enseigne'] = out['CA5'] - out['CA4']
    out['Effet_client'] = out['CA6'] - out['CA5']
    out['CA_arrivee_calculé'] = (out['CA_depart'] 
                                  + out['Nouveaux_couples_client_produit_format']
                                  + out['Couples_perdus_client_produit_format']
                                  + out['Effet_volume_pénétration']
                                  + out['Effet_prix']
                                  + out['Effet_produit']
                                  + out['Effet_format']
                                  + out['Effet_enseigne']
                                  + out['Effet_client'])
    out['CA_arrivee_réel'] = out['CA_arr_reel']
    out['Ecart_reconciliation'] = out['CA_arrivee_réel'] - out['CA_arrivee_calculé']
    
    out = out[[colmap['marque'], colmap['dist'], 'Periode_arrivee', 'CA_depart',
               'Nouveaux_couples_client_produit_format', 'Couples_perdus_client_produit_format',
               'Effet_volume_pénétration', 'Effet_prix', 'Effet_produit', 'Effet_format',
               'Effet_enseigne', 'Effet_client', 'CA_arrivee_calculé', 'CA_arrivee_réel', 'Ecart_reconciliation']]
    
    results.append(out)

# ========================= Empilement multi-périodes =========================
df = pd.concat(results, ignore_index=True)

cat = pd.Categorical(df['Periode_arrivee'], categories=order, ordered=True)
df = df.assign(Periode_arrivee=cat).sort_values(['Marque','Distributeur','Periode_arrivee'], ascending=[True, True, True]).reset_index(drop=True)
